description: Canonical handoff contract for the Governed Semantic-Intent Bridge Packet emitted by IDE-2 to the Principle Alignment Module.
invariants: The original M1 IG-G reference is read-only and traceable.
Semantic displacement must be represented explicitly.
Coherence must be measurable at the bridge boundary.
Drift alerts must propagate to PAM without silent suppression.
downstream_requirement: PAM uses the governed bridge packet as its upstream input for principle alignment and clearance evaluation.
